limitations: World state compiled from 06_world/world.sqlite (partial mechanical artifact per 06_admission.json); purpose derivations read admitted semantic tuples only.
SOW-VEL-2022 has no clause_kind_presence tuples in world; Vellum invoice INV-4001 is excluded from purpose A because no active contract carries acquisition-relevant clauses.
record_identifier CRM rows in world use crm:crm:<id> form from prior pass; purpose B/C derivations use identity_judgment identifiers directly and do not depend on record_identifier.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Pure mechanical rendering; no semantic judgment. Each source record maps to one canonical purpose-B identifier string.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is the union of rows in the four fact relations; one identifier per source record referent.
derivations.required_premise: Source fact tuples exist with stable keys (invoice_id, account_id, company_number, contract_id).

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical filter on billing status; no epistemic disposition.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is invoice_fact; completeness over all invoices regardless of contract linkage.
derivations.required_premise: invoice_fact.status is authoritative for open vs closed.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose-local association disposition maps world identity and governing-contract judgments to asserted or unresolved. Missing positive linkage is unresolved, not negative.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row universe: invoices with an active governing contract bearing at least one PRESENT acquisition-relevant clause_kind, plus invoices blocked solely by unresolved identity or governing-contract linkage on that same candidate contract.
derivations.required_premise: Active contract (contract_temporal_fact.active = true) with at least one acquisition clause_kind PRESENT from {change_of_control_consent, change_of_control_termination, assignment_notice_or_consent, assignment_consent, assignment_notice, assignment_competitor_prohibition, competitor_assignment_prohibition}; ASSERTED invoice_governing_contract with billing-to-contract counterparty connected by SAME_ENTITY direct or transitive path.
derivations.optional_enrichment: invoice_governing_contract_candidate supplies contract_id when governing linkage is not yet ASSERTED but identity-unresolved blocking is in scope.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: association becomes unresolved when billing-to-contract counterparty identity is not SAME_ENTITY
association becomes unresolved when governing contract linkage is not ASSERTED

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: does not qualify a contract for acquisition exposure; row excluded unless another acquisition kind is PRESENT
CRM/registry pairwise links unresolved do not block asserted billing-to-contract association when that direct pair is SAME_ENTITY

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Projection of admitted identity_judgment tuples into purpose B schema; epistemic field preserves SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or UNRESOLVED without closed-world inference.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is the bounded candidate pair set already admitted to identity_judgment (commercially linked CRM, billing, contract, registry records).
derivations.required_premise: identity_judgment tuples use prescribed identifier forms (crm:, billing:, registry:, contract:).
derivations.optional_enrichment: record_identifier may align referent keys but is not required for rendering output links.

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: emitted explicitly as epistemic UNRESOLVED; absence of SAME_ENTITY is not DISTINCT

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Two-part conjunctive test yields dependent when current relationship and qualifying obligation kinds hold with resolved joins; unresolved when required invoice-contract-counterparty linkage is UNRESOLVED.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row universe: each active contract–counterparty combination that is purpose-dependent or blocked solely by unresolved identity/linkage needed for the two-part test.
derivations.required_premise: Active contract (contract_temporal_fact.active = true) with at least one obligation clause_kind PRESENT from {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term}, current commercial relationship via open invoice on ASSERTED governing link OR continuing term (auto_renewal or rolling_term PRESENT), and billing-to-contract counterparty connected by SAME_ENTITY direct or transitive path when governing link is ASSERTED.
derivations.optional_enrichment: record_identifier supplies counterparty rendering when multiple referent forms exist; billing: identifier preferred from linked invoice.

blocking_unresolved_state.effect: status unresolved when billing-to-contract identity required for the join is not SAME_ENTITY

non_blocking_unresolved_state.effect: excluded from obligation_kinds list; does not alone block dependent if another kind is PRESENT
CRM/registry pairwise unresolved links do not block dependency when invoice-to-contract billing identity is SAME_ENTITY and governing contract is ASSERTED
expired contracts excluded from row universe; not emitted as unresolved
